title: Keep private generation context out of published outputs
abstract: Do not reproduce private source conversations, drafting language, or internal instructions in public-facing outputs merely because they informed the creation of those outputs. Authorization to create or publish a result does not itself authorize disclosure of its private drafting context.
remarks: Intake-only abstraction. Exposure of source phrasing or instructions is the proposed boundary, including cases where no independently confidential fact is disclosed. No rule normalization or processing has occurred.
